title: Cloud Security: collection suspension
content:
Cloud Security collection suspension is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

The contract status is active.

Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice payment term in calendar days plus collection grace term in calendar days after the source invoice is issued.

The contract payment restriction status is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal.

Starting from the source invoice issue time, add the specified invoice payment term and then the collection grace term as UTC calendar dates, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation.

Equality qualifies.

The source overdue invoice must retain a positive unpaid principal; a fully paid invoice cannot justify suspension.

Earlier handling sends an informational explanation without a status change.

An agent suspends active service only when official payment restriction status is restricted; ordinary billing disputes alone do not suspend service.

Retained ancillary resources can still produce actual supplemental usage.

Repeated handling of an already suspended contract makes no new transition.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable suspend action, authoritative system records must establish: The contract status is active. The evidence is bound to the same Security contract reference.

### Authoritative eligibility 2

Before the applicable suspend action, authoritative system records must establish: Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice payment term in calendar days plus collection grace term in calendar days after the source invoice is issued. The evidence is bound to the same Security event reference.

### Authoritative eligibility 3

Before the applicable suspend action, authoritative system records must establish: The contract payment restriction status is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal. The evidence is bound to the same Security contract reference, Security event reference.

The suspension timing comparison uses the frozen handling time.

## Basis Q&A

**Does an already suspended contract transition again?**

Repeated handling of an already suspended contract makes no new transition.

## Suspension time boundary

Hypothetical cases: just before the calculated collection boundary, handling gives an informational explanation without changing status. Exactly at the boundary, the timing condition is met; active status, official restriction and unpaid source principal are still required.
